core_obligations: Construct the fractional-moment renewal law and derive a subexponential partition-function criterion.

compared.difference: Old 2687 concerns smoothness near the quenched critical point, not strict separation of quenched and annealed critical points at large beta. Annealed exponents and curve scaling do not imply this criterion.
